---
title: "جب غم شبیرؑ میں سب مبتلا ہو جائیں گے"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Jab gham-e-shabbir mein sub, mubtila ho jaayenge

1
Kashtiy-e-insaniyaat ke, nakhuda ho jaayenge.
Jab gham-e-shabbir mein sab
Is liye hotay hai jaa ke, karbala mein sajda re
Is liye hotay hai jaa ke, karbala mein sajda re
Khaaq ho kar ek din hum kimiya ho jaayengayyyyy

2
Majlisi tehzeeb sikhlati hai qadray zindagi
Majlisi tehzeeb sikhlati hai qadray zindagi
Be-adab jo hai adab say aashnaa ho jayengayyyyy

3
Inkay sadqay mein to paayi hai seratay mustaqeem
Inkay sadqay mein to paayi hai seratay mustaqeem
Hum gham-e-shabbir say kaisay judaa ho jayengayyyyy

4
Bay naway-e karbala ka saath do aai saathiyo
Bay naway-e karbala ka saath do aai saathiyo
Rafta rafta sub mukhaalif humnawaa ho jayengayyyyy

5
Jab chalay abbas dariya par to zainab ne kahaa
Jab chalay abbas dariya par to zainab ne kahaa
Chal basay tum bhi to hum phir be-ridaa ho jayengayyyyy

6
Kyaa khabar thi kalmago dhaayenge aisay bhi sitam
Kyaa khabar thi kalmago dhaayenge aisay bhi sitam
Be-rida balway mein aalay mustafa ho jaayengayyyyy

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu-script body and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`. The opening and all six stanzas align line for line, including repeated lines. Set the direction to `rtl`, added the Roman title, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

Rendered the ambiguous “sajda re” as `سجدہ رے`, preserving the recorded syllables. `git diff --check` passed.
